lead: Jackie Chan is an American film actor, born on 7 April 1954 in Victoria Peak.
As of 2026, he is 72 years old, and his birth date places him under the Aries sign.

He is associated with work such as Drunken Master, The Young Master and Project A and has held the office of UNICEF Goodwill Ambassador and member of the National Committee of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference.
This profile collects the Jackie facts readers search for most — date of birth and current age, height and physical stats, family and relationship details, education, and a dated career timeline.

sections.heading: Jackie Chan — Early Life, Family and Education
paras: Jackie Chan was born on 7 April 1954 in Victoria Peak, and holds citizenship of United States, People's Republic of China and British Hong Kong. He was given the name 陳港生 at birth and is publicly known as Jackie Chan.
Public records name his father, Charles Chan and his mother, Lee-Lee Chan.
He received his education at Dickson College.
He is recorded as speaking English, Yue Chinese and Standard Chinese.

sections.heading: Jackie Chan — Career and Professional Work
paras: His professional record lists film actor, film producer, screenwriter, stunt performer, film director and choreographer as his occupations, including work with UNICEF.
Among the credits most often linked to Jackie are Drunken Master, The Young Master, Project A, Police Story, Rush Hour and Armour of God.
He has held the following offices: UNICEF Goodwill Ambassador and member of the National Committee of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference.
